title: PetSafe ScoopFree Crystal Classic Self-Cleaning Cat Litter Box, Gray
say: Customers have mixed opinions about the litter box's quality, with some loving it while others find it horrible. The cleaning performance receives mixed feedback, with some saying it works well while others report issues with the rake stopping completely. Moreover, the odor control keeps litter areas from stinking, and customers appreciate not having to scoop daily. However, the absorbency and durability receive negative feedback, with customers reporting it doesn't soak up urine and breaking within a month. Additionally, the size receives mixed reactions, with some finding it big enough while others find it too large, and customers consider it not worth the cost.
